title: U.S. Cleared Nvidia Chips to Chinese Firms With Empty Offices and Troubling Ties
summary: The Commerce Department has approved dozens of Chinese companies to handle Nvidia’s H200 chips, some of which have ties to firms under sanctions over national security.
